extraction_notes: HEICO 10-K (FY2022) is notably generic about Pentagon exposure. The filing describes broad defense/space end-markets (TWTAs, MPMs for radar/EW/jamming; precision-guided munitions antennas; missile-seeker simulation/test; satellite microwave components; military rotorcraft self-sealing fuel systems; military comms RF receivers; nuclear radiation detectors) but does NOT name specific Program Elements (PEs), program-of-record line items, IDIQ ceilings, or dollar revenue attributed to any named DoD program. The single named platform mentioned anywhere in the slice is F-16 (FSG aftermarket support to foreign military operators). This is a CONTROL-style filing for the J-Book divergence cohort: there is no specific PE the framework can hook into. We extract the few quantitative defense-mix disclosures and the F-16 platform mention as J-Book-grounded candidates; the rest are control claims.
